findings.title: Restore the frozen intent-cancellation outcome in I03
findings.description: The i03_dc oracle requires only CallLedgerService.CancelUndispatched versus PermitDispatch. That owner cancels a RESERVED reservation and updates S27 accounting payload, not the intent status. After DISPATCH_INTENT it rejects cancellation. Frozen DB section 5.1 requires the dispatch-first order to cancel/end the intent while preserving the possible-call reservation occupation. Therefore this check can pass with the root still RUNNING and does not prove the assigned I03 frozen ordering or loss of future planning/dispatch authority.
findings.requested_change: Refine the I03 packet/backlog/check projection to exercise the actual CancelIntent outcome in both orders: cancel-first terminal root with exact RESERVED release and permit denial; dispatch-first terminal root with unchanged DISPATCH_INTENT occupation, no refund/resend, and denied future worker authority. Explicitly name an exact guarded test-local CancelIntent owner recipe if the merged restricted owner can provide the complete frozen result; otherwise add a bounded owner prerequisite. Keep the reservation-cancellation race as additional evidence rather than substituting it for I03. Regenerate derived hashes and rerun governance checks before fresh review.

findings.title: Declare a legitimate PAUSED-state owner prerequisite for positive RESUME
findings.description: continue_resume_current_dc requires a successful typed RESUME preserving START history and forbids raw PAUSE/state seeding. The actual merged lock_execution guard requires PAUSED plus an existing START, while every current START/CONTINUE/RESUME mutation must set IN_PROGRESS. ProtocolExecutionService exposes publish/commit/start only; no source PAUSE service or owner exists. Historical transaction coverage creates PAUSED with privileged raw SQL. KL075/076 do not own S44, and KL077 only declares the existing T6/T7 commit/continuation/resumption adapters. The stated prerequisite and write/owner scope therefore cannot produce the positive RESUME state. On an IN_PROGRESS session, the post-revoke/expiry RESUME denial also exits at lifecycle validation before checking current authorization, so it can be vacuous.
findings.requested_change: Declare an exact authenticated internal ExecutionService pause/stop lifecycle operation in a bounded prerequisite or explicitly scoped KL077 owner capability, preserving the 39 public commands, frozen S51/S01/aggregate/receipt order as applicable, immutable START binding, atomic execution-basis event/bookkeeping, and TEST boundary. Require an actual START then owner-produced PAUSED then successful RESUME. For revoke/expiry negative checks, start from a lifecycle-valid PAUSED session (or a separately labeled guard-only negative fixture), assert the current authority rejection reason, and ensure lifecycle failure cannot satisfy the revoke/expiry oracle. Update dependency/packet/backlog/hash projections and rerun checks before fresh review.
